blocks.text: Thai superstar Win Metawin is returning to the Philippines on Tuesday, November 24, for an exclusive luxury fragrance and beauty event in Taguig City. The actor and regional brand ambassador will make a special appearance at a beauty pop-up at SM Aura. News of his upcoming visit quickly sparked excitement among Filipino fans across social media platforms.
